summary: The module docstring's entry for `sum_orderOfVanishingAt_add_elliptic_add_qExpansionOrderAtCusp_eq` claims `hoff`/`hga` are still hypotheses when the proof constructs both, contradicting the theorem's own docstring; and every prose description of the divisor set names only the completeness condition `hcomp`, silently dropping the equally restrictive `hSfd`.
